characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: A sturdy, earth‑tone linen tunic reaching mid‑thigh, slightly worn at the cuffs from frequent use, paired with dark brown leather breeches that tuck neatly into calf‑high woolen socks. Over this she wears a thick, cream‑colored canvas apron tied snugly around her waist; the apron is lined with a faded green cotton interior and features a small pocket on the left side where she keeps a damp cloth. A worn leather belt cinches the tunic at the waist, holding a silver keychain that doubles as a tool for locking doors. She wears no hat or headgear, keeping her hair pulled back in a simple braid to keep it out of the way while serving ale
characters.role: takes care of a tavern for magical humanoid creatures
